numerical_checks.derivation: For constant tau,mag: Delta(y0+(y-y0+tau*dy/TC)/mag)=(dy+tau*(dy-dy_prev)/TC)/mag; dy_0=0. No correction needed. Variable coefficients intentionally act on current increments only.

effect_check.rule: >=25% peak reduction in >=2 cases plus >=2x correction of an originally <0.5*truth window on original trajectory
